entities.summary: Norvel Pelle Jr. is a Lebanese-Antiguan professional basketball player who last played for the Knox Raiders of the NBL1 South. A 6-foot-10-inch (2.08 m), 231-pound (105 kg) center, he played at three different high schools in the Los Angeles area and was ranked as one of the top recruits in his class. He was prohibited from competing in college after failing to meet academic requirements, choosing to immediately turn professional in 2013.
